name: god-close
prompt: God's enormous face watches the little world below, eyes moving slowly, blinking once, eyebrows lifting; the clouds around him drift. Static camera.

name: god-distance
prompt: A slow push-in toward the little world as God watches it from far away, clouds drifting past, his eyes following something below. Slow steady zoom in, nothing else changes.

name: god-biting-lip
prompt: The old man in the sky bites his lip and winces, eyes darting, as the people stream out of the movie theater below chatting; the clouds drift slowly. Static camera.

name: truman-sailboat
prompt: Truman stands in his little sailboat and knocks on the painted sky wall with his fist, again and again, the boat rocking gently on the waves, the sail swaying. Static camera.

name: art-projects-b
prompt: Slow gentle push-in on the ants at work: the painter ant strokes the canvas, the crayon ant colours, scissors snip, a stray ant carries a paper scrap across the floor.

name: ant-cities-b
prompt: Slow camera drift downward through the ant cities as the ants work: the crane turns, bricks are carried up ladders and over bridges, ants stream between the buildings, water ripples in the lowest chamber.

name: theater-jars-b
prompt: Slow push-in toward the screen where the jarred ant pounds on the glass; the audience ants flinch and clutch their popcorn, one drops a kernel; below, the tunnel ants keep working.

name: glass-marquee-b
prompt: Slow tilt up from the two ants at the bottom to the glowing marquee, the bulbs chasing around the sign, the line of ants shuffling in through the doors.
